title: action params: a missing required param is refused in English only at the REST action door and MCP run_action, while the console says it in the reader's language
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czKnDE6hsyXQzB9wB2

Filing gate: ② out-of-scope finding while building #35659 (PR #35716, dev report 7028248527); filed on the seat's word. ⛔ Not a claim.

**What.** `enforceActionParams` (`packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts:3774`) refuses a missing or blank required action param with `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` through `validateActionParams` (`packages/spec/src/ui/action-params.zod.ts:197`). That sentence is English-only at the REST action door and at MCP `run_action`. The console's record-page dialog says the same thing through its translated `requiredError` (`isMissingValue`), so a person working in zh-CN gets a localized sentence in the console and an English one from the API or an AI agent.

**Reach.** Since #35659, every reject without a reason hits this refusal (approval_reject's `comment` is now required). It also applies to every other action with a required param.

**Ask.** Serve the param-contract refusal in the requester's language, using the same catalog the console uses or the server-side refusal catalog the platform already uses for other refusals. Keep the code and status unchanged. Pin one non-English locale at the REST door.

Suggested-grade: p3 · a localized-message gap on an existing refusal; the behaviour is correct.
Dedupe: `validateActionParams` (1 hit: #35659 itself), `action param refusal localized` (3 hits, none on this).
